label: Шкаф «Катания-4.2»
hangingLayout: four fixed front-to-back end brackets across full depth range
assumptions: Base and dimension ranges, four overlay doors, 80 mm plinth and 30 mm overlap are transcribed from supplied screenshots.
The configurator uses fixed front-to-back clothing brackets over depth 400–600 mm; the supplier switches to transverse rods at 500 mm. Automatic layout switching is outside this model contract.
Four equal hanging bays with one upper shelf each; exact internal dimensions, board/front/back thicknesses and fittings are visual engineering estimates.
Groove count 48 per door, 3 mm mouth, 1.8 mm depth and 0.25 mm chamfers are visual estimates. Groove section/count stay fixed; flat land widths grow with door width.
Facade top/bottom cuts expose the fluted section, as in the panel reference. Case panel bevel is 0.7 mm; the grooves have fixed cross-section chamfers.
Handles are 800 mm long with 28 mm projection, estimated from photographs. Overall depth includes their closed projection.
Default graphite finish is the existing shared board-graphite-matte, an approximation of the main photo.
Door motion is the existing visual Y-axis hinge approximation, not manufacturing hinge kinematics. Bracket extension is not an interactive articulation.
Perforation pitch 128 mm is recorded from the card; unused adjustment holes and concealed fasteners are omitted from render geometry.
